title: Study-002 dossier
body:
# Study-002 dossier: virtual brain twins for treatment choice (Wang et al. 2025 virtual patients)

**Status:** exploratory. Research on virtual (simulated) patients; not a clinical recommendation.

## Answer to the study question
- **EZ recovery on the blinded test patient (P2): not achieved.** The inversion pipeline was not qualified (v2 benchmark A0037 failed: planted EZ ranked 2nd, x0 R-hat up to 4.7; v3 benchmark A0040 failed: P(EZ rank 1) 0.012, NUTS never finished warm-up; R5 gates A0042). The frozen exploratory P2 estimates (A0017-A0019) missed the true single-region EZ (Left-F1-lateral-prefrontal): recall 0 in every window, true-EZ rank 46-159 of 162 (A0043).
- **Best virtual intervention: not determinable.** On the fitted (unqualified) model, ablation of the estimated EZ + PZ reduced seizing regions most (median -3.0, 5-95% -4.9 to -1.6; all seizures abolished in 42% of 12 samples); sustained-current SEEG stimulation -0.5 to -1.0; the paper's 50 Hz pulse train gave no benefit; high-amplitude pulse-train arms failed numerically (A0038, reproduced bit-exactly by R5, A0041). On the true model the patient did not seize spontaneously in the region-level simulator, so no candidate (including ablating the true EZ) could show an effect; rank concordance is undefined and all 9 predicted reductions in the full window had the wrong sign (A0043).

## Why it failed (lessons)
1. Model mismatch: data generated by the authors' richer (6D/neural-field) model cannot be reproduced by the 2D Epileptor fitted with a linear log-power observation map; more parameters, better priors or samplers did not fix this (A0037, A0040).
2. Paradigm mismatch: P2's seizure is stimulation-induced and short (~4 s), but the inversion had no stimulation input and few observations; the true model does not seize spontaneously, so treatment effects must be evaluated under the observed stimulation protocol (not done; next step).
3. The controller's safeguards worked: benchmarks exposed the failure before any claim; truth stayed sealed until predictions were frozen (freeze seq 205, reveal seq 214); every simulation was reproducible.

## Next steps
- Simulation-based inference with the full model (scan candidate EZs by simulating the observed stimulation protocol and matching SEEG features), benchmarked first on synthetic data.
- Re-evaluate treatments under the observed stimulation protocol (stimulation-induced seizures), with neural-field simulation using the patient anatomy (data/wang-co2-ana) and TI mapped via the ico5 region map (need N001).

## Records
Protocol A0001 (+ amendments A0012, A0015); data A0002, A0009, A0011; method A0006/A0013; benchmarks A0037, A0040; P2 predictions A0017-A0019 (frozen 1fcf288a...); R4 A0034, A0035, A0038; R5 A0041, A0042, A0043, A0044.
